name: Costs - Budget vs actual cost tracking
description: Verifies cost management: viewing baseline vs actual costs, catalog management, and execution cost tracking

planSteps.description: Log in and navigate to /dashboard/costs and select an existing order
Assert that the cost page shows budget vs actual comparison with labor, materials, and equipment breakdowns
Assert that variance percentages are calculated and color-coded (green for under budget, red for over budget)
Navigate to /dashboard/costs/catalog and verify the cost catalog with standard labor rates and material prices
Click on an order with execution data and view the execution cost breakdown
Assert that execution costs from labor hours and materials are reflected in the actual cost vs budget comparison
